headline: Jim Cramer: Bending Spoons Is A ‘Really Good’ Software Company, Recommends Buying This Industrial Stock
summary: Jim Cramer recommends buying Howmet Aerospace Inc. (NYSE: HWM) and Farmers National Banc Corp. (NASDAQ: FMNB), and says Bending Spoons S.p.A. (NASDAQ: BSP) is a good software company. He is not a fan of AMC Entertainment Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: AMC) but says it's fine for speculation. Coherent Corp. (NYSE: COHR) is at the right level to buy and Establishment Labs Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: ESTA) has a positive outlook according to Mizuho analyst.
